pixel_sigma: median(abs(normalized rfft2) over RGB, all rows and interior x-frequency columns)*sqrt(HW/log(2)); same estimator as frozen spectral pilot
phase_estimator: For past adjacent spectra F_j, C=sum_j sum_RGB F_j*conj(F_(j-1)). A=mean_j sum_RGB abs(F_j)^2, B=mean_j sum_RGB abs(F_(j-1))^2. qa=mean_j 3*sigma_j^2/HW, qb=mean_j 3*sigma_(j-1)^2/HW. phase qualifies iff m>=8, min(max(A-qa,0)/qa,max(B-qb,0)/qb)>16 and abs(C)/((m-1)*sqrt(A*B))>=.8. theta=arg(C) if qualified else0. DC and self-conjugate points theta0. No current observation enters theta.
alignment: Past observation at frame j is multiplied by exp(i*theta*(current_frame-j)). Current DC always retained. Real self-conjugate points do not rotate; FFT x-boundary columns force conjugate y-row theta and masks for real reconstruction.
prediction_and_selection: Past aligned mean vs current. RGB-shared innovation if any channel magnitude difference exceeds3*sqrt(current_sigma^2+sum_past_sigma^2/m^2)/sqrt(HW). Select current coefficient on innovation, otherwise current-inclusive aligned mean. Hard sharedRGB support if maxabs(selected_RGB)>4*selected_nominal_sigma/sqrt(HW). DC kept. No soft shrink.
state: History cut at reset or any jitter change; current-inclusive count<=64. Valid source history retained even after invalid pilot; no truth/guide/history external input. Nonfinite/negative/>65504 pilot falls back exact current raw whole frame inactive, no clipping.
qualification: Posthoc CPU source-only feasibility on13 old authenticated fixture families; no new native response, quality acceptance or proven effectiveN. Phase parameter uncertainty and correlated noise are not included in nominal variance; no threshold sweep or outcome-based variant selection.
